t: LL-37 for hard-to-heal venous leg ulcers, first human trial (2014)

f: The two lower doses shrank ulcers by 50–68% and healed 3–6 times faster than placebo; the highest dose did not help.
cr: Grönberg et al. · Wound Repair Regen 2014 · Sweden

t: TESTS: thymosin α1 for sepsis, phase 3 (2025)
who: 1,106 adults with sepsis in 22 Chinese ICUs, 7 days
f: 28-day death rate was the same as placebo (23.4% vs 24.1%).
cr: Wu et al. · BMJ 2025 · China

t: ETASS: thymosin α1 for severe sepsis (2013)
who: 361 adults with severe sepsis in 6 Chinese hospitals
f: Deaths were 26.0% vs 35.0%, a borderline result in a single-blind trial; the larger 2025 trial did not confirm it.
cr: Wu et al. · Crit Care 2013 · China

t: Hexarelin protects rat hearts, mainly through CD36 (2003)
who: Rats, hearts tested after blood flow was cut and restored
f: Hexarelin gave about 45–60% protection against heart damage, far more than ghrelin, mostly through CD36.
cr: Torsello et al. · Endocrinology 2003 · Italy

t: ATTAIN-1: oral orforglipron for obesity, phase 3 (2025)
who: Adults with obesity, 72 weeks
f: Weight fell 11.2% on 36 mg vs 2.1% on placebo; 18% on 36 mg lost 20% or more. Stomach side effects were common.
cr: Wharton et al. · N Engl J Med 2025 · Canada

t: Survodutide in MASH and liver fibrosis, phase 2 (2024)
who: 293 adults with biopsy-proven MASH and fibrosis, 48 weeks
f: MASH improved in 47–62% on survodutide vs 14% on placebo; nausea hit 66%.
cr: Sanyal et al. · N Engl J Med 2024 · USA

t: SYNCHRONIZE-1: survodutide for obesity, phase 3 (2026)
who: 725 adults with obesity, 76 weeks
f: Weight fell 12.2–13.0% vs 5.4% on placebo, counting everyone who started. The 16.6% on this page is not in the abstract.
cr: le Roux et al. · N Engl J Med 2026 · Ireland

t: GLORY-1: mazdutide in Chinese adults with obesity, phase 3 (2025)
who: 610 Chinese adults with obesity or overweight, 48 weeks
f: Weight fell 14.0% on 6 mg vs a 0.3% gain on placebo. The 9 mg result on this page comes from a different trial.
cr: Ji et al. · N Engl J Med 2025 · China

t: Eloralintide for obesity, 48-week phase 2 (2025)
who: 263 adults with obesity, 48 weeks
f: Weight fell up to 20% on 9 mg vs 0.4% on placebo; nausea and fatigue rose at higher doses.
cr: Billings et al. · Lancet 2025 · USA

t: Injected amycretin, phase 1b/2a (2025)
who: 125 adults with overweight or obesity, up to 36 weeks
f: Weight fell 24.3% on 60 mg at 36 weeks vs 1.1% on placebo; stomach side effects were frequent.
cr: Dahl et al. · Lancet 2025 · Denmark

t: VENTURE: VK2735 injections, 13-week phase 2 (2026)
who: 174 adults with obesity, 13 weeks
f: Weight fell up to 14.7% on 15 mg vs 1.7% on placebo in just 13 weeks.
cr: Bays et al. · Obesity 2026 · USA

t: Monthly maridebart cafraglutide for obesity, phase 2 (2025)
who: 592 adults with obesity, with or without type 2 diabetes, 52 weeks
f: Weight fell 12.3–16.2% vs 2.5% on placebo, counting everyone who started; about 20% applies to those who stayed on drug.
cr: Jastreboff et al. · N Engl J Med 2025 · USA

t: IMPACT: pemvidutide for MASH, phase 2b (2025)
who: 212 adults with MASH, 24 weeks
f: MASH cleared in 52–58% vs 20% on placebo; fibrosis did not improve more than placebo.
cr: Noureddin et al. · Lancet 2025 · USA

t: ZUPREME 1: petrelintide for obesity, phase 2 (2026)
who: 485 adults with obesity, 28 weeks
f: Weight fell 7.9–9.8% vs 1.7% on placebo at 28 weeks, with mild nausea mostly during dose increases. The 10.7% on this page is a later time point not in the abstract.
cr: Garvey et al. · Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2026 · USA

t: Ecnoglutide in Chinese adults with obesity, phase 3 (2025)
who: 664 Chinese adults with overweight or obesity, 40 weeks
f: Weight fell 13.2% on 2.4 mg vs a 0.1% gain on placebo.
cr: Ji et al. · Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2025 · China

t: ACTIVE: abaloparatide in postmenopausal osteoporosis, phase 3 (2016)
who: 2,463 postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, 18 months
f: New spine and non-spine fractures fell vs placebo and bone density rose; high calcium was rarer than with teriparatide (3.4% vs 6.4%).
cr: Miller et al. · JAMA 2016 · USA

t: ACTIVE: abaloparatide in postmenopausal osteoporosis, phase 3 (2016)
who: 2,463 postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, 18 months
f: High blood calcium happened in 3.4% on abaloparatide vs 6.4% on teriparatide.
cr: Miller et al. · JAMA 2016 · USA

t: Teriparatide (PTH 1-34) in postmenopausal osteoporosis (2001)
who: 1,637 postmenopausal women with prior spine fractures, about 21 months
f: New spine fractures fell from 14% to 4–5%; spine bone density rose 9–13 points more than placebo.
cr: Neer et al. · N Engl J Med 2001 · USA

t: Bimagrumab in type 2 diabetes and obesity, phase 2 (2021)
who: 75 adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity, 48 weeks
f: Fat mass fell 20.5% (7.5 kg) vs 0.5% on placebo, while lean mass rose 3.6%.
cr: Heymsfield et al. · JAMA Netw Open 2021 · USA

t: Bimagrumab in type 2 diabetes and obesity, phase 2 (2021)
who: 75 adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity, 48 weeks
f: Lean mass rose 1.7 kg (3.6%) vs a small loss on placebo, alongside the fat loss.
cr: Heymsfield et al. · JAMA Netw Open 2021 · USA

t: Tesofensine for obesity, phase 2 (2008)
who: 203 adults with obesity, 24 weeks
f: Weight fell 9.2–10.6% on 0.5–1 mg vs 2.0% on diet and placebo; dry mouth, insomnia and a faster heart rate were common.
cr: Astrup et al. · Lancet 2008 · Denmark

t: Tesofensine for obesity, phase 2 (2008)
who: 203 adults with obesity, 24 weeks
f: Heart rate rose about 7 beats per minute on the 0.5 mg dose; blood pressure did not rise at the lower doses.
cr: Astrup et al. · Lancet 2008 · Denmark

t: EXSCEL: weekly exenatide and heart outcomes (2017)
who: 14,752 adults with type 2 diabetes, about 3 years
f: Heart events: 11.4% vs 12.2% on placebo, safe but not clearly better.
cr: Holman et al. · N Engl J Med 2017 · UK

t: LAVENDER: trofinetide for Rett syndrome, phase 3 (2023)
who: 187 females with Rett syndrome, 12 weeks
f: Behaviour, overall improvement and communication scores beat placebo modestly; diarrhoea hit 81%.
cr: Neul et al. · Nat Med 2023 · USA

t: PHIRST: tadalafil for pulmonary arterial hypertension (2009)
who: Adults with pulmonary arterial hypertension, 16 weeks
f: The 40 mg dose added 33 m to the 6-minute walk and cut clinical worsening; lower doses did not reach significance.
cr: Galiè et al. · Circulation 2009 · Italy

t: Low-dose methylene blue and brain MRI, placebo-controlled (2016)
who: 26 healthy adults aged 22–62, single low oral dose
f: Correct answers in a memory test rose 7%, with more brain activity on MRI.
cr: Rodriguez et al. · Radiology 2016 · USA

t: Creatine and brain performance in vegetarians, crossover (2003)
who: 45 young adult vegetarians, 6 weeks each arm
f: Working memory and reasoning test scores rose on 5 g a day creatine vs placebo.
cr: Rae et al. · Proc Biol Sci 2003 · Australia

t: ARA 290 for diabetic neuropathy, phase 2 (2015)
who: Adults with type 2 diabetes and nerve pain, 28 days
f: Nerve pain scores and HbA1c improved; small corneal nerve fibres regrew in those with the biggest loss.
cr: Brines et al. · Mol Med 2015 · USA

t: Adipotide causes weight loss in obese monkeys (2011)
who: Obese monkeys of three species
f: Adipotide killed the blood vessels feeding white fat, causing fast weight loss and better insulin response.
cr: Barnhart et al. · Sci Transl Med 2011 · USA

t: Adipotide causes weight loss in obese monkeys (2011)
who: Obese monkeys of three species
f: At working doses, monkeys showed predictable, reversible changes in kidney tubule function.
cr: Barnhart et al. · Sci Transl Med 2011 · USA

t: CARS: Cerebrolysin and recovery after stroke (2015)
who: Adults in early rehabilitation after stroke, 90 days
f: Arm function recovered much better than placebo, with a small to medium gain in overall outcome; the authors call it exploratory.
cr: Muresanu et al. · Stroke 2015 · Romania

t: Thymosin β4 gel for venous leg ulcers, phase 2 (2010)
who: 73 adults with venous leg ulcers, Italy and Poland
f: Safe at every dose; the 0.03% gel hinted at faster healing, with about 1 in 4 fully healed within 3 months, mostly small or moderate ulcers.
cr: Guarnera et al. · Ann N Y Acad Sci 2010 · Italy

t: Copper peptide gel heals diabetic foot ulcers, placebo-controlled (1994)
who: Adults with diabetic foot ulcers, several clinics, plain gel as control
f: Ulcers closed 98.5% (median) vs 60.8% with plain gel, about three times faster, with fewer infections (7% vs 34%).
cr: Mulder et al. · Wound Repair Regen 1994 · USA

t: PROGRESS-HF: elamipretide in weakened hearts, phase 2 (2020)
who: 71 adults with heart failure (pumping 40% or less), 4 weeks
f: Daily injections were well tolerated but did not change heart size or pumping versus placebo.
cr: Butler et al. · J Card Fail 2020 · USA

t: One elamipretide drip in heart failure, phase 1 (2017)
who: 36 adults with heart failure (pumping 35% or less), one 4-hour drip
f: No serious side effects; the highest dose shrank heart volumes slightly by the end of the drip, effect gone within a day as the drug cleared.
cr: Daubert et al. · Circ Heart Fail 2017 · USA

t: Ipamorelin GH pulse in healthy men (1999)
who: 40 healthy men, five doses into a vein
f: Every dose set off one GH pulse peaking at about 40 minutes and then fading; ipamorelin itself cleared with a 2-hour half-life.
cr: Gobburu et al. · Pharm Res 1999 · USA

t: Hexarelin and heart pumping in people (2001)
who: 7 healthy adults, 7 GH-deficient adults, 12 with dilated cardiomyopathy
f: One IV dose raised heart pumping in healthy and GH-deficient people, even without a GH rise in the latter, but not in failing hearts.
cr: Broglio et al. · Endocrine 2001 · Italy

t: Semax raises blood BDNF after stroke, patients (2018)
who: 110 adults in rehabilitation after ischemic stroke
f: Semax courses raised blood BDNF, which stayed high, and patients regained daily function faster (Barthel score).
cr: Gusev et al. · Zh Nevrol Psikhiatr 2018 · Russia · in Russian

t: Semaglutide in alcohol use disorder, phase 2 (2025)
who: 48 adults with alcohol use disorder, 9 weeks
f: Low-dose semaglutide cut alcohol drunk in a lab drinking test, drinks per drinking day and craving; the number of drinking days did not change.
cr: Hendershot et al. · JAMA Psychiatry 2025 · USA

t: Semaglutide 2.4 mg, appetite and eating (2021)
who: 72 adults with obesity, 20 weeks, placebo-controlled
f: Ate 35% fewer calories at a free lunch, felt less hungry, had fewer and weaker cravings, and lost 9.9% of weight vs 0.4%.
cr: Friedrichsen et al. · Diabetes Obes Metab 2021 · Denmark

t: Semaglutide 2.4 mg, appetite and stomach emptying (2021)
who: 72 adults with obesity, 20 weeks, placebo-controlled
f: By week 20 there was no clear slowing of stomach emptying on a paracetamol test; the small difference vanished after adjusting for weight. Hunger and calories eaten still fell.
cr: Friedrichsen et al. · Diabetes Obes Metab 2021 · Denmark

t: SURPASS-CVOT: tirzepatide vs dulaglutide and heart events, phase 3 (2025)
who: 13,165 adults with type 2 diabetes and heart or vessel disease
f: Heart attack, stroke or heart death in 12.2% vs 13.1% on dulaglutide: at least as good, not proven better; more stomach side effects.
cr: Nicholls et al. · N Engl J Med 2025 · Australia

t: MK-677 at bedtime and sleep quality (1997)
who: 8 young and 6 older adults, 1 to 2 weeks at bedtime, placebo-controlled
f: The high dose lengthened deep sleep by about 50% and REM sleep by over 20% in young adults; older adults gained nearly 50% more REM.
cr: Copinschi et al. · Neuroendocrinology 1997 · Belgium

t: Low-dose hCG keeps sperm production on testosterone therapy (2013)
who: 26 men on testosterone plus 500 IU hCG every other day, records reviewed
f: Semen stayed unchanged for over a year, no man stopped making sperm, and 9 fathered a pregnancy.
cr: Hsieh et al. · J Urol 2013 · USA

t: Daily tadalafil for enlarged-prostate symptoms (2008)
who: 1,058 men with urinary symptoms from an enlarged prostate, 12 weeks
f: Every daily dose eased urinary symptoms vs placebo, with 5 mg the best balance; urine flow speed did not change.
cr: Roehrborn et al. · J Urol 2008 · USA

t: Tesamorelin in HIV with belly fat, phase 3 (2007)
who: 412 adults with HIV and extra belly fat, 26 weeks
f: IGF-1 rose 81% vs a 5% fall on placebo, showing the GH axis switched on; deep belly fat fell 15.2%.
cr: Falutz et al. · N Engl J Med 2007 · Canada

t: LL-37 turns the body's own DNA into an immune alarm (2007)
who: Human immune cells and psoriasis skin samples
f: LL-37 binds the body's own DNA so immune cells read it as an infection and release interferon; the authors propose this drives psoriasis.
cr: Lande et al. · Nature 2007 · USA

t: DSIP injections in severe insomnia, open study (1984)
who: 7 people with severe insomnia, 10 injections, no placebo group
f: Sleep returned to normal in 6 of 7 for 3 to 7 months, with better daytime mood and performance.
cr: Kaeser · Eur Neurol 1984

t: Thymosin α1 for chronic hepatitis B, randomized (1998)
who: 98 adults with chronic hepatitis B, 26 or 52 weeks of injections vs no treatment
f: The 26-week course cleared the virus markers in 40.6% vs 9.4% untreated, 18 months in; liver inflammation improved and no significant side effects.
cr: Chien et al. · Hepatology 1998 · Taiwan

t: Semax in rehabilitation after stroke (2018)
who: 110 adults in rehabilitation after ischemic stroke
f: Semax courses raised blood BDNF, which stayed high, and patients regained daily function faster (Barthel score).
cr: Gusev et al. · Zh Nevrol Psikhiatr 2018 · Russia · in Russian

t: Semaglutide reaches hunger centres in the brain, rodents (2020)
who: Mice and rats
f: Semaglutide reached the hypothalamus, brainstem and septal area through gaps in the blood-brain barrier, switched on 10 brain areas, cut food intake and changed food choice; weight fell without lower energy burn.
cr: Gabery et al. · JCI Insight 2020 · Denmark

t: Semaglutide reaches hunger centres in the brain, rodents (2020)
who: Mice and rats
f: Semaglutide acted directly on the brainstem (area postrema) and hypothalamus, then on meal-stopping neurons in the parabrachial nucleus; food intake and weight fell.
cr: Gabery et al. · JCI Insight 2020 · Denmark

t: MK-677 for 2 years in healthy older adults (2008)
who: 65 healthy adults aged 60–81, 25 mg daily or placebo, randomised
f: GH and IGF-1 rose to young-adult levels and lean mass rose 1.1 kg vs −0.5 kg. Bigger appetite was the most common side effect and faded within a few months; fasting glucose rose and insulin sensitivity fell.
cr: Nass et al. · Ann Intern Med 2008 · USA

t: MK-677 for 2 years in healthy older adults (2008)
who: 65 healthy adults aged 60–81, 25 mg daily or placebo, randomised
f: Bigger appetite was the most common side effect and faded within a few months. The hunger effect was reported, not measured in the brain.
cr: Nass et al. · Ann Intern Med 2008 · USA

t: Epitalon in old rhesus monkeys: melatonin and blood sugar (2005)
who: Old (20–27 years) and young rhesus monkeys
f: In old monkeys epitalon raised night-time melatonin and lowered fasting glucose and insulin; it did nothing in young monkeys.
cr: Goncharova et al. · Exp Gerontol 2005 · Russia

t: GHK-Cu and learning in aged mice, preprint (2026)
who: Mice aged 20–21 months, by nose for 8 weeks or injected for 5 days
f: Nasal GHK-Cu sped up maze learning in both sexes; the 5-day injections gave only a brief gain in males. Preprint, not yet peer reviewed.
cr: Mazzola et al. · Research Square 2026 · USA

t: Pineal peptides and the night melatonin rhythm in old monkeys and elderly people (2007)
who: Old monkeys and elderly people with low pineal function
f: Epitalon and the pineal extract Epithalamin raised night melatonin and brought the daily rhythm back toward normal. Small studies, abstract only; full paper in Russian.
cr: Korkushko et al. · Adv Gerontol 2007 · in Russian

t: Retatrutide phase 1b in type 2 diabetes (2022)
who: 72 adults with type 2 diabetes, 12 weeks
f: Daily average blood sugar fell about 2.8–3.1 mmol/L and HbA1c 1.2–1.6% vs placebo at the top three doses. The GIP-driven insulin boost itself comes from lab work, not this trial.
cr: Urva et al. · Lancet 2022 · USA

t: Retatrutide from discovery to first human doses (2022)
who: Obese mice, plus a single-dose phase 1 study
f: In obese mice the GLP-1 and GIP parts cut calorie intake and the glucagon part raised energy burn; weight stayed down 43 days after one human dose. Brain regions were not mapped.
cr: Coskun et al. · Cell Metab 2022 · USA

t: Tirzepatide on eating behaviour, 6-week phase 1 with brain scans (2025)
who: 114 adults with overweight or obesity, no diabetes
f: Ate 524.6 kcal less at a free lunch vs placebo by week 3, with less hunger, fewer cravings and less overeating. Brain response to sweet fatty food fell in reward and memory areas (orbitofrontal cortex, cingulate, hippocampus); the hypothalamus itself was not shown.
cr: Martin et al. · Nat Med 2025 · USA

t: Thymosin beta-4 speeds knee ligament healing, rats (2013)
who: Rats with a cut knee ligament (MCL)
f: A single 1 µg dose placed in the gap gave neater collagen and a stronger ligament at 4 weeks. Ligament, not tendon; no human study.
cr: Xu et al. · Regul Pept 2013 · China

t: Tesamorelin and inflammation markers in HIV belly fat (2011)
who: 410 people with HIV and belly fat, 2 mg daily or placebo, 26 weeks
f: The clotting marker tPA fell slightly more than placebo; PAI-1 and CRP showed no treatment effect. Changes tracked belly-fat loss.
cr: Stanley et al. · AIDS 2011 · USA

t: Low-dose tesamorelin pilot: cognition, sleep and more (2026)
who: 22 adults, normal thinking to mild cognitive impairment, 1 mg or placebo, 10 weeks
f: No significant change in sleep, fatigue, cognition or body measures vs placebo. Small pilot.
cr: Stewart et al. · eNeurologicalSci 2026 · USA

t: Bremelanotide and desire circuits in the brain, female rats (2007)
who: Female rats (review of the preclinical work)
f: Raised sexual solicitation when injected or put straight into the medial preoptic area, not the ventromedial hypothalamus; may work by switching on dopamine terminals there.
cr: Pfaus et al. · J Sex Med 2007 · Canada

t: Bremelanotide safety across the clinical programme (2022)
who: 3,500 people in 43 studies; 1,247 in the phase 3 double-blind part
f: Focal darkening was rare at the label dose but showed in more than a third of people after up to 16 daily doses in a row.
cr: Clayton et al. · J Womens Health 2022 · USA

t: Bremelanotide safety across the clinical programme (2022)
who: 3,500 people in 43 studies, with 24-hour blood pressure monitoring
f: Small, short-lived but real rises in blood pressure; advised caution with heart disease risk. Nausea 40%, flushing 20%.
cr: Clayton et al. · J Womens Health 2022 · USA

t: KPV calms inflammation signals in human airway cells (2012)
who: Human bronchial airway cells in the lab
f: KPV blocked NF-κB and cut the inflammation signals IL-8 and eotaxin by stopping p65 entering the nucleus. Cells only; no plain-KPV animal or human lung study.
cr: Land · Int J Physiol Pathophysiol Pharmacol 2012 · UK

t: GHRH and sleep in healthy seniors (1997)
who: 13 healthy adults around 69 years, native GHRH 4 × 50 µg or placebo
f: Fewer night awakenings and a longer first deep-sleep period, with more GH; weaker than the deeper slow-wave sleep seen in young men. Native GHRH, not CJC-1295 itself; no sleep study of CJC exists.
cr: Guldner et al. · Neurobiol Aging 1997 · Germany

t: Plain Selank raises BDNF in rat hippocampus (2008)
who: Rats given plain Selank in the nose
f: Plain Selank changed BDNF levels in the hippocampus. Not the N-acetyl amidate form, which has no published study.
cr: Inozemtseva et al. · Dokl Biol Sci 2008 · Russia

t: Plain Selank vs medazepam in anxiety disorder (2008)
who: 62 people with generalised anxiety or neurasthenia; 30 on Selank
f: Calmed anxiety as well as medazepam, with extra anti-fatigue effect; blood enkephalin breakdown slowed (half-life rose) on Selank. Plain Selank, not the NA form; full paper in Russian.
cr: Zozulia et al. · Zh Nevrol Psikhiatr 2008 · in Russian

t: Plain Semax raises BDNF and TrkB in rat hippocampus (2006)
who: Rats, one nasal dose of plain Semax
f: BDNF protein rose 1.4-fold and TrkB activation 1.6-fold in the hippocampus, with better learning. Not the N-acetyl amidate form.
cr: Dolotov et al. · Brain Res 2006 · Russia

t: Plain Semax and brain growth factors after stroke, rats (2011)
who: Rats with reduced blood flow to the brain
f: Plain Semax reversed the fall in growth factor genes in the hippocampus, strongest 12 hours after the blockage. Not the NA form; full paper in Russian.
cr: Stavchanskii et al. · Mol Biol 2011 · in Russian

t: Thymalfasin to prevent COVID-19 in dialysis patients, pilot (2023)
who: 194 dialysis patients, 1.6 mg twice weekly for 8 weeks or no treatment
f: Preliminary report: 3 deaths on thymalfasin vs 7 without, COVID serious events 5 vs 7. Final results not yet published.
cr: Tuthill et al. · Int Immunopharmacol 2023 · USA

t: ACHIEVE-1: orforglipron in early type 2 diabetes, phase 3 (2025)
who: 559 adults with type 2 diabetes on diet and exercise only, 40 weeks
f: HbA1c fell 1.24–1.48 points vs 0.41 on placebo; no severe low blood sugar. Weight fell 4.5–7.6%. Stomach side effects mostly mild, during dose increases.
cr: Rosenstock et al. · N Engl J Med 2025 · USA

t: Full thymosin beta-4 speeds skin wound healing, rats (1999)
who: Rats with full-thickness skin wounds
f: Full Tβ4 (on the skin or injected) raised wound cover by 42% at day 4 and up to 61% at day 7, with more collagen and new vessels. Full protein, not the 17–23 fragment.
cr: Malinda et al. · J Invest Dermatol 1999 · USA

t: Full thymosin beta-4 speeds skin wound healing, rats (1999)
who: Rats with full-thickness skin wounds
f: More new blood vessels and collagen in treated wounds. Full protein, not the 17–23 fragment.
cr: Malinda et al. · J Invest Dermatol 1999 · USA

t: Full thymosin beta-4 and heart repair after a heart attack, mice (2004)
who: Mice after a blocked heart artery, plus heart cells in the lab
f: Full Tβ4 switched on the survival signal Akt, kept more heart muscle cells alive and improved heart function. Full protein, not the 17–23 fragment.
cr: Bock-Marquette et al. · Nature 2004 · USA

t: LL-37 stops bacterial biofilms forming, lab (2008)
who: Pseudomonas bacteria in the lab
f: LL-37 blocked biofilm formation at 0.5 µg/mL, far below the dose needed to kill the bacteria (64 µg/mL), and broke up existing biofilms. Lab only; gut not tested.
cr: Overhage et al. · Infect Immun 2008 · Canada

t: Nightly GHRH 1-29 analogue for 4 months in older adults (1997)
who: 19 adults aged 55–71, randomised, placebo then 16 weeks of nightly injections
f: GH and IGF-1 rose, skin thickened, men gained lean mass and libido; sleep quality on questionnaires did not change in either sex.
cr: Khorram et al. · J Clin Endocrinol Metab 1997 · USA

t: Kisspeptin-10 strongly raises LH in men (2011)
who: Healthy men, IV doses and infusions
f: LH rose from 4.1 to 12.4 IU/L within 30 minutes at the best dose; a 22.5-hour infusion raised LH 5.4 → 20.8 and testosterone 16.6 → 24.0 nmol/L, with more frequent LH pulses (a sign of more GnRH).
cr: George et al. · J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2011 · UK

t: Kisspeptin and sexual brain processing in men with low desire (2023)
who: 32 men with low sexual desire, randomised crossover vs placebo
f: Changed activity in the brain's sexual-processing network on fMRI, raised penile response to sexual videos by up to 56% and 'happiness about sex'. Used kisspeptin-54 by IV, not kisspeptin-10.
cr: Mills et al. · JAMA Netw Open 2023 · UK

t: Melanotan II starts erections in men, double-blind crossover (1998)
who: 10 men with erectile dysfunction with no physical cause
f: 8 of 10 had clear erections; strong rigidity lasted 38 minutes vs 3 on placebo. Nausea, yawning and lower appetite were more common than on placebo.
cr: Wessells et al. · J Urol 1998 · USA
